data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store, my overall recommendation is **Stripe** — unless you're already using Shopify, in which case I'd choose **Shopify Payments**\.

The best option depends on your ecommerce platform, where your customers are located, and how much you sell.

Assuming you're operating in Australia, here's how I'd compare the main options.

## Best payment processors for a small store

![Stripe Conversion Tracking – Able Customer Data Platform](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uLblf37t9qmSgXH90IIrfyM1cEVlAyfeKTR0KIuJzNcMC_B2ZUJW9p7BftOV-yzXikVmn2jDYU_Zq1ExkRO0GTjHIMaYqcU4RzMNo1YrpDxk3GXGSNzey-FFdr644M2DVq4UsY3Zo9OE1wDfp2BQqWf9beRf_8lKhubJp-AjxGHf8Zwil7Ew0fyQc0BJ2PlA?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Straightforward setup
- Excellent integrations with WooCommerce and other platforms
- Supports cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay
- No standard monthly processing fee

Australian domestic card pricing: approximately 1.65% + A\$0.30.

[Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify
- Easy order and refund management
- Supports digital wallets
- Avoids additional third-party transaction fees imposed by Shopify

[Shopify Payments Australia](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

(Best additional payment option)

- Familiar and trusted by many shoppers
- Customers can pay using their PayPal accounts
- Useful as an alternative checkout method
- Fees can be higher than standard card processing

[PayPal Australia](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![Airwallex Logo Vector PNG | Modern Global Payments Brand Icon  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cFbGTguMuX4NolZbruyR2e9UuMWzIcApce9GwnB52sKTkNYR004hxhoF8Ij9azaRbMXEJgKRHsclL3c7QjB8TJjaOTDcrg4k3A5inD7vzblx0d1z3hgdBOQOwY04EZUWK2_K2j2_0mXQsLUCmgN2eSvYqOiDe6vtcOsjp3z8pqXOq4rreZAlQfF7YiTD92T7?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Airwallex**

(Best for international sales)

- Competitive domestic card fees
- Multi-currency payment capabilities
- International business accounts
- Useful if you sell overseas

[Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

## Australian fee comparison

Indicative published rates from a 2026 comparison\:

| Processor | Domestic online card fee |
|--------|--------|
| Stripe | 1.65% + \$0.30 |
| Airwallex | 1.65% + \$0.30 |
| Shopify Payments | 1.75% + \$0.30 (Basic) |
| PayPal | 2.90% + \$0.30 |
| Square | Around 2.2% |


Rates depend on card type, plan and transaction type. International cards can cost more. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/au/blog/payment-processing-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd personally choose

For a new small online store\:

- **WooCommerce\:** Stripe + PayPal.
- **Shopify\:** Shopify Payments + PayPal.
- **Selling internationally\:** Stripe or Airwallex.
- **Selling online and in person\:** Square is worth considering.

I'd avoid overcomplicating things initially. One main processor and PayPal as an alternative checkout option is a sensible starting point.

## Let me narrow it down to the best one for your store

**1\. What platform does your store use?**
